questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 600. After allowing a discount of 25% on the marked price, there was a loss of Rs. 30. The loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP = Rs. 600,

Discount = 25%,

Loss = Rs.30

**Formula Used:**

Loss = CP – SP

Loss % = (CP – SP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

SP = 600 × 75/100 = Rs.450

Loss = CP – SP

⇒ 30 = CP – 450

⇒ CP = Rs.480

%Loss = (30/480) × 100 = 6.25%.

**∴ The loss percentage is 6.25%**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 19, xyz = 216 and xy + yz + zx = 114, then the value of √(x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz) is:
questions.solution:
Given x + y + z = 19 and xy + yz + zx = 114

Consider, x + y + z = 19

Squaring on both sides, we get

(x + y + z)² = (19)²

x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) = 361

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 361 − 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 361 – 2 × 114 = 133

∴ x² + y² + z² = 133

We know that x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)( x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 19 × [133 – 114]

On adding 4xyz both sides,

x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz = 19 × 19 + 4 × 216 = 1225

Taking square root on both sides,

√(x³ + y³ + z³ + xyz) = √1225 = 35.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z³ = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)² - 3(xy + yz + zx) + 3xyz

Calculation:

We have-

√(x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz)

⇒ √[(x + y + z){(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)} + 3xyz+ xyz]

⇒ √19 × (19² - 3 × 114) + 4 × 216

⇒ √19(361 - 342) + 864

⇒ √19 × 19 + 864

⇒ √1225

⇒ 35

∴ The required value is 35.

questions.question: If 2cos²θ – 5cos θ + 2 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cosec θ + cot θ) is:
questions.solution:
⇒ 2cos²θ – 5cos θ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2cos²θ – 4cos θ – cosθ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2cosθ(cosθ – 2) – 1(cosθ – 2) = 0

⇒ (2cosθ – 1)(cosθ – 2) = 0

⇒ cosθ = (1/2, 2)

(∵ value of cosθ can not be beyond 1, ∴ take cosθ = ½)

cosθ = ½ = cos60°

⇒ θ = 60°

On putting in (cosecθ + cotθ) = (cosec60° + cot60°)

⇒ (2/√3) + (1/√3) = 3/√3 = √3.

questions.question: In ΔABC, D is a point on side AB such that BD = 2 cm and DA = 3 cm. E is a point on BC such that DE || AC, and AC = 4 cm. Then (Area of ΔBDE) : (Area of trapezium ACED) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47abe6c72c27e034fff28b8d9e3caa01bac610c9690456fe82bb063077185b7c.png] 

Using Thales theorem,

BD : AB = DE : AC

∴ the ΔBDE is similar to ΔABC

Theorem: The ratio of sides of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the square root of the area of two triangles.

∴ the ratio of the area of the two triangles ΔBDE: ΔABC = (2: 5)² = 4: 25

The area of the trapezium ACED = 25k – 4k = 21k

The ratio of the area of the ΔBDE : Trapezium ACED = 4K : 21K = 4 : 21.

questions.question: What is the difference between the compound interest, when interest is compounded 5-monthly, and the simple interest on a sum of Rs. 12,000 for 1{ 1 over 4} years at 12% per annum?

Principal = Rs. 12,000

Time = 1{ 1 over 4} years = 5/4 

Rate = 12% 

Condition for C.I. = 5-monthly compound interest

Condition for S.I. = yearly

**Concept used:**

Condition = 5-monthly compound interest

New Time = Time × 12/5

New Rate = Rate ÷ 12/5

Effective rate for S.I. = Rate × Time 

**Calculations:**

New time = (5/4) × 12/5 = 3 years

New rate = 12% × 5/12 = 5%

For 1st two durations = 5 + 5 + 25/100 = 10.25%

For next 3rd duration = 10.25 + 5 + (10.25 × 5)/100 = 15.7625%

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 43x1145y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (3x – 2y), for the smallest value of y, is:
questions.solution:
To check the divisibility by 88,

It should be divisible by 8 and 11.

We know that the last three digits of a number should be divisible by 8.

⇒ The number made from the last three digits without altering their position will be divisible by 8

⇒ Possible values of y are 1, 5 and 9

∵ y is the smallest, the value of y will be 1.

Now, let's check the divisibility rule of 11,

⇒ 4 + x + 1 + 5 + 2 - (3 + 1 + 4 + y)

⇒ 12 + x - 9 = 3 + x

Hence the possible value of x will be 8.

∴ Value of (3x – 2y) = 3 × 8 - 2 × 1 = 22

questions.question: A man spends 72% of his income. If his income increases by 28% and his expenditure increases by 25%, then what is the percentage increase or decrease in his savings (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Let the income and expenditure be 100x and 72x respectively.

Savings = Income – Expenditure = 100x – 72x = 28x

New income = 100x + 100 × 28/100 = 128x

New expenditure = 72x + 72x × 25/100 = 90x

New savings = 128x – 90x = 38x

Required percentage = (38x – 28x)/28x × 100 = 35.7%

questions.question: A and B can complete a task in 25 days. B alone can complete 33(1)/(3)\% of the same task in 15 days. In how many days can A alone complete {(4)/({15)}th} of the same task?
questions.solution:
B’s time taken to complete 33(1)/(3)\% or 1/3rd of the total work = 15 days

B’s time taken to do the complete work = 3 × 15 = 45 days

Total work = LCM of (A + B)’s time taken and B’s time taken.

Total work = LCM of 25 and 45 days = 225 units

(A + B)’s efficiency = 225/25 = 9 units/day (∵ efficiency = total work/time taken)

B’s efficiency = 225/45 = 5 units/day

A’s efficiency = (9 – 5) = 4 units/day

{(4)/({15)}th} of the same task = 225 × 4/15 = 60 units

A’s time taken to this work = 60/ 4 = 15 days

questions.question: By selling 72 articles, a loss equal to the selling price of 8 articles was incurred. What is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price and selling price of per article are CP and SP.

Given, Loss = 8 × SP

Also,

Loss = 72 × CP – 72 × SP

⇒ 8 × SP = 72 × CP – 72 × SP

⇒ 80 × SP = 72 × CP

⇒ CP/SP = 80/72

Loss percentage = (80 - 72)/80 × 100 = 10%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a63c93e11c1bd5840d125804b189a0e6fab4be6ad12b4d33c13eace1e72ac42b.png] 

Let SP of an article = Re 1

Hence, total SP = 72 and loss = 8

now, CP = SP + loss = 80

Loss percentage = (8/80) × 100 = 10%

questions.question: A man travels a certain distance at 12 km/h and returns to the starting point at 9 km/h. The total time taken by him for the entire journey is 2(1)/(3) hours. The total distance (in km) covered by him is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the distance traveled be 2x.

Distance traveled in each directions = x 

Since, Time taken = Distance/Speed

According to the question,

⇒ x/12 + x/9 = 7/3

⇒ x = 12 km

**∴ The total distance travelled by the man = 2 × 12 = 24 km (Forward and**

**backward)**

**Formula used:**

Average speed = 2ab/(a + b)

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Average speed = 2 × 12 × 9/(12 + 9)

⇒ 2 × 12 × 9/21

⇒ 72/7 km/h

Distance = (72/7) × (7/3)

⇒ 24 km

**∴ The required distance is 24 km.**
